interval.tooltip: How often the taskbar readout and the hover popup refresh. Lower = more realtime, higher = lighter.

show-cpu.tooltip: Display the total CPU usage percentage in the taskbar text

show-memory.tooltip: Display used RAM in the taskbar text

show-network.tooltip: Display download/upload rates (▼▲) in the taskbar text

popup-network.tooltip: Speeds, totals, link speed, MAC, IP and gateway inside the hover card

popup-system.tooltip: Overall CPU %, memory used/total inside the hover card

popup-cores.tooltip: One bar per CPU core inside the System section
